productCrawlActionFailure.error: Error: Firecrawl crawl did not complete within 30 status polls; retry with a smaller limit.
productCrawlActionFailure.rootCause: captureCrawlSnapshot passes no pollDelayMs, so the adapter's 30 status polls burn back-to-back before a real crawl completes (see aeoIntel.recordCrawlSnapshot comment; dedupe half fixed in #173, delay gap remains).
productCrawlActionFailure.resolution: Recorded as a product gap; the proof proceeded through the same Firecrawl adapter with pollDelayMs 2000 and a real DNS resolver, then recorded the snapshot via the public aeoIntel.recordCrawlSnapshot mutation.
